'''Case''' (Japanese: '''クレイ''' ''Clay'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW081|Crisis at Ferroseed Research!]]''. He is a scientist and an assistant to [[Professor Malveaux]], working at the [[Ferroseed Research Institute]].

Case greeted {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, {{an|Cilan}}, and [[Georgia]] when they came to visit the Institute, and he gave them a tour through the building. While doing so, however, the moss created by some of the {{p|Ferroseed}} broke free from one of the laboratories and began covering the building and its surroundings. Iris, her {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, [[Ash's Oshawott]], and Georgia's {{p|Vanilluxe}} became stranded on the roof, while Case and the others were able to escape.

Case followed Iris's progress in wiping out the moss with {{type|Ice}} attacks. He later assessed how Cilan, Georgia, and Professor Malveaux were doing in saving the Ferroseed and, eventually, the Institute.
